aspect: The bias runs in both directions
description: Some patients are assumed to be exaggerating and are undertreated; others are assumed to be drug-seeking and are undertreated. Both assumptions produce the same outcome.
Clinicians are described as not deliberately dismissing, but noticing distress and subconsciously reclassifying it - which is what makes it hard to address and impossible to report.
energy_note: Nobody meant it, and she is still in pain.
